column1: 1M companion to the completed 30.2M property-specialist study: eleven targets x uniform/90%-target/100%-target x five fitting seeds. This is a three-point weight comparison, not a dense search. Uniform loss is 1/11 per task; priority90 uses .90 target and .01 each auxiliary; target_only uses 1.0 target and zero auxiliary losses. All arms retain eleven plain MLP heads, identical initial weights per seed, balanced eight-per-task batches, 100 steps/epoch, full encoder fine-tuning, fixed cross-ion attention, 200-epoch cap and patience 15. Same frozen complete-IL split and training-only standardization. The only intended scientific change relative to the 30.2M specialists is the three-pass 1M encoder initialization. A numerical safeguard replays the saved best checkpoint on its fitting device against saved selected-epoch predictions, with the unchanged 5e-6 training-SD tolerance. Historical 1M single-task/all-task-selected MTL are contextual controls with different stopping criteria. Tabular selection uses validation across six configurations; its test minimum is descriptive only. Native CO2 and ln-viscosity MAEs remain distinct. Repeatedly inspected test split is exploratory.
Every new fit selects and early-stops on its target validation standardized MSE only. Choose among the three weights using five-seed mean target validation MSE; no test selection.
New target-only control retains all heads and identical balanced sampling; zero auxiliary losses. It is not an MoE.
Five-seed means are mean errors of five models, not errors of an ensemble predictor. Partial-seed values never enter the comparison figure.
Paired intervals: 5000 whole-IL resamples of seed-averaged absolute-error differences, conditional on fitted models. Negative delta favors the specialist.
Sign randomization: 10000 whole-IL sign draws. BH over 66 tests (11 tasks x 3 controls x 2 weightings), only after all production fits complete.
Tabular observed test minimum selects among six configurations by mean test MAE, not best seed; descriptive only, no associated significance claim.
All task errors, including auxiliary losses, are retained in Per_seed; compare only target==task for the specialist portfolio.
Original low-precision tabular values are restored in memory only when four archived metrics agree; original files remain untouched.
Repeated test inspection, one chemical split, few held-out ILs and unverified Cp source units limit generalization claims.
